newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: SPOT SAUDI RIYAL EASES, RIYAL DEPOSITS STEADY.
newsitem.headline: SPOT SAUDI RIYAL EASES, RIYAL DEPOSITS STEADY.

text.p: The spot Saudi riyal eased against the dollar this week in a liquid market but riyal interbank deposit rates were barely changed, dealers said on Wednesday.
"Liquidity is back to the market causing a lower spot riyal," one Riyadh-based dealer said. The riyal was quoted at 3.7505/06 to the dollar from 3.7502/04 a week earlier.
Dealers said activity concentrated mainly on forwards.

One-month interbank riyal deposits were quoted at 5-7/8, 3/4 percent, three-month funds were put at 5-15/16, 13/16 percent, six month deposits were 6-1/16, 5-15/16 percent and one-year maturities were quoted at 6-1/4, 1/8 percent.
